extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: A4 clipboard, approx. 23 x 33.5 cm, 2.9 cm high at the clip
extras.notes: lies flat, clip end = +Y; honey-wood board, three white sheets, the top one with coloured bars instead of text (coral header, sky-blue lines, small boxes); charcoal steel clip with riveted base plate and hinge pin. The clamp jaw with its press lever 'clipboard_lever' is a separate object with its origin on the hinge axis: rotate around local X, negative angles open the jaw (approx. down to -30 degrees); no text, no logo

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
